note: Instagram location tags (owner 2026-11-07, QUEUE G17). Zernio sends platformSpecificData.locationId to Instagram as location_id: the ID of a Facebook place Page with location data (docs: zernio-php docs/Model/InstagramPlatformData.md, read 2026-11-07). Instagram feed posts, Reels and carousels only; Facebook has no location field in Zernio. City-level tags only, each ID seen in an archived or live facebook.com place URL (11-09: facebook.com/<id> redirects to the city's 'Things to do in <City>' place page). Events tag their record's city unless the title says 'near' (the venue is outside the city); deals tag only when listed under items. A rejected tag is retried once without it (tools/social-post.mjs). Add a city only with an evidence URL.
